FN-6YTI733-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 584
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Jeana Ross
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/11/2026
House Bill 584 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board
of Education and the State Department of Education (SDE) to (1) adopt standards for screen
time use for children in kindergarten through 5th grade; (2) prepare an annual progress report on
screen-time instruction to the Governor and Legislature; and (3) ensure compliance with the
provisions of this bill. Additionally, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the
local boards of education to adopt policies consistent with the State Board of Education.
Finally, this bill would create the Elementary Instructional Technology Task Force within SDE
to provide recommendations to the State Board of Education on screen-based instruction.

FN-6YTI733-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 584
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Jeana Ross
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/12/2026
House Bill 584 as reported by the Committee on Education Policy would increase the
administrative obligations of the State Board of Education and the State Department of
Education (SDE) to (1) adopt standards for screen time use for children in kindergarten through
12th grade; (2) prepare an annual progress report on screen-time instruction to the Governor and
Legislature; and (3) ensure compliance with the provisions of this bill. Additionally, this bill
would increase the administrative obligations of the local boards of education to adopt policies
consistent with the State Board of Education.
Finally, this bill would create the Instructional Technology Task Force within SDE to provide
recommendations to the State Board of Education on screen-based instruction.
